description: Permanently deletes one contact from the account's Google Contacts. There is no undo through this API (the Google Contacts UI keeps its own 30-day trash, but nothing here reads or restores it) — verify the resource_name with get_contact before deleting. Returns an empty result on success. After an ambiguous failure (timeout/5xx; never auto-retried) check with get_contact before re-sending: the delete may already have happened, and a second attempt then fails with 404.

resource_name.description: The contact's full resource name, e.g. "people/c1234567890" — exactly as returned by list_contacts, search_contacts or create_contact.

name: delete_contact
title: Delete a contact
